residency.rule: At least 30 semester hours and at least 25 percent of undergraduate coursework must be completed at Averett; transfer students must complete at least 12 major hours at Averett; degree recipients must complete their last 30 semester hours of class work at Averett.

canonical_path.warning: The 52-credit major includes a three-credit unresolved placeholder solely to expose the catalog's published-minus-enumerated difference. It is not a course or a repair.

modeling_notes: The authoritative current catalog publishes one shared Computer Science major for the B.A. and B.S.; the B.A.-only intermediate-language condition is a zero-additional-unit gate inside Society and Culture General Education.
Eleven fixed rows contribute 37 credits, the statistics choice contributes three, and the elective block contributes nine, for 49 enumerated credits. The catalog nevertheless prints Total 52.
A separate three-credit unresolved requirement node preserves the published-minus-enumerated difference. It does not name a course, and specifically does not use sample-plan-only CSC 306.
The final three-credit elective line is retained as one unresolved university requirement because the PDF omits the connector between CSC 300+ and MTH 200+ pools. Neither AND nor OR is inferred.

General Education is modeled at its published 30-credit minimum: six written-communication credits, category minima of six Society and Culture, six Humanities and Creativity, seven Scientific and Quantitative, and five additional credits distributed within the published category ranges.

The 38-credit capacity after the published 52-credit major and 30-credit General Education minimum includes the catalog's 18-21-credit traditional-major minor/related-field architecture and other applicable credit. Its internal distribution remains an analysis constraint rather than an invented course list.

data_quality_flags.message: The current catalog prints a 52-credit major, but its enumerated categorical requirements sum to 49.
The final three-credit elective line does not publish an AND or OR connector between the CSC 300+ and MTH 200+ pools.
CSC 306 occurs only in the excluded Sample Four-Year Course Sequence and is not a categorical requirement.
The exact split of the 38-credit remainder between the 18-21-credit minor/related-field architecture and other applicable credit depends on the selected path and overlap.
